name: dsh-restart-confirm
description: Sidebar restart button for DeepSeek Harness with double confirmation: one click opens a two-step confirm flow, then restarts the dsh web process (WebUI + backend, one process) and auto-relaunches it with the same args. Cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows), no hardcoded paths, configurable. / DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏一键重启按钮（带二次确认）：点击后需连续两次确认才会重启 dsh web 进程（WebUI 与后台同属该进程），并以相同参数自动重新拉起。跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows），无硬编码路径，可配置。
